title: Art History, B.A. (College of Arts and Architecture)
notes: Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (raw HTML tables, same DOM-extraction approach used for the 2026 build, not innerText). The 8-semester course sequence, semester-by-semester credit loads (16/16/16/15/15/15/15/12 = 120 total), and every specific course placement (ARTH 1S + Additional Course in Semester 1, Additional Course x2 in Semesters 2-3, ARTH 350W in Semester 6, CAS 100 in Semester 4, ENGL 202 in Semester 7, and the IL/US B.A. Knowledge Domain tags landing on Semester 5/Semester 6 respectively) are byte-identical to 2023-24 and 2024-25, and structurally identical to 2025-26/2026-27 (this app's ARTH-2026.json) -- confirmed by diffing the raw extracted Program Requirements text across all 5 years. Two real, verified differences from the 2026 file: (1) the 2022-23 bulletin's own Additional Courses approved list (the Program Requirements Course List table, footnote 1) is ARTH 100, 105N, 107N, 111, 111U, 111Z, 112, 112U, 120, 120Z, 130, 140, 201, 202N, 220Z -- three more codes (111Z 'Ancient to Medieval Art Z', 120Z 'Asian Art and Architecture -LINKED', 220Z 'Chinese Art - Linked') than the 2026 list, which dropped all three Linked-course variants; Semesters 2 and 3's 'Additional Course' option lists here include all three, still excluding ARTH 111 since it's already used in Semester 1. (2) Semester 6's 'World Cultures' slot is labeled 'Other Cultures' here, matching the 2022-23 bulletin's own University Requirements section ('Bachelor of Arts students must take 3 credits in Other Cultures') -- the university-wide rename to 'World Cultures' (and 'Foreign Language' Gen Ed category to 'World Language') took effect starting the 2024-25 catalog per the archived bulletins; the semester grid's own per-item row label stayed literally 'Foreign Language' across every year checked (2022 through 2026), including 2026's own JSON, so that item is unchanged here. Also confirmed present in this year's own bulletin, matching 2026's convention of leaving it unmodeled: the geographic-distribution category names read 'Africa and the Middle East' / 'Asia and the Pacific' here (vs. 2026's shortened 'Africa' / 'Asia') and the archived page's Advising Notes section spells out three sub-rules not modeled as literal course-code prereqs here either -- '3 credits of major Additional or Supporting Courses must include Architectural History', 'at least 12 credits of Supporting Courses must be at the 400 level or higher (ARTH 495 excluded)', and (not previously called out in the 2026 file's own notes) 'at least 3 credits of Supporting Courses must be in Prehistoric-1600' -- all three are non-course-code advising gates the schema doesn't represent directly, same standing convention as every other major built this session. The broader Gen Ed knowledge-domain credit totals in this year's Degree Requirements prose differ from 2026's (this catalog predates the university's Gen Ed restructuring), but the actual semester-by-semester slot count and credit values in the Suggested Academic Plan grid are unchanged, so no schema-level change was needed to reflect that. 'Support Course Geographic Area', 'Support Course Art History Elective', and plain 'Elective' slots are wired to open_elective with the same ARTH-only elective_exclude_prefixes as 2026, matching the real 'select ARTH courses ... in consultation with an adviser' category described in this year's own bulletin text.
